Content following a table whose last row is never closed is still converted

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><th>Before</th></tr><tr></table><p>Visible footer</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
